## Summary

Download and reproject global bathymetry from GEBCO:

* GEBCO Compilation Group (2026). GEBCO 2026 Grid (sub-ice topo/bathy).
* Product page: https://www.gebco.net/data-products/gridded-bathymetry-data#global
* Download link: https://dap.ceda.ac.uk/bodc/gebco/global/gebco_2026/sub_ice_topography_bathymetry/netcdf/GEBCO_2026_sub_ice.zip?download=1

The raw 15-arcsecond (~0.00417°) NetCDF is downloaded, aggregated by a factor of 12, and saved at 0.05° resolution to `_data/gebco_2026/`. The original 7 GB file is deleted after aggregation.

## Methods

Make sure to manually add these to .gitignore!

### Download NetCDF

```{r}
local_f <- here::here('_data/gebco_2026', 'GEBCO_2026_sub_ice', 'GEBCO_2026_sub_ice_0.05.nc')
if(!file.exists(local_f)) {
  src_url <- 'https://dap.ceda.ac.uk/bodc/gebco/global/gebco_2026/sub_ice_topography_bathymetry/netcdf/GEBCO_2026_sub_ice.zip?download=1'
  destfile <- here::here('gebco.zip')
  download.file(src_url, destfile, mode = 'wb')

  exdir <- here::here('_data/gebco_2026')
  unzip(destfile, exdir = exdir)
  file.remove(destfile)

  ### aggregate to 0.05 degree resolution (from 0.00416667)
  ### downloaded and unzipped files:
  f_raw <- here::here('_data/gebco_2026', 'GEBCO_2026_sub_ice', 'GEBCO_2026_sub_ice.nc')
  r_raw <- rast(f_raw)
  r1 <- aggregate(r_raw, 12)

  writeRaster(r1, local_f)
  unlink(f_raw) ### 7 GB file!
}
```
